summary: Vulcan Infrastructure and Power Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing a privately negotiated exchange agreement dated September 23, 2026, with certain holders of its 8.50% Senior Notes due 2026. The Company will issue $2,833,358 principal of new 10.00% Senior Notes due 2030 plus three-year warrants to purchase 1,000,000 Class A shares at $1.87, in exchange for $2,793,150 principal of 2026 Notes plus about $40,230 accrued interest. Closing is expected on or about October 1, 2026. Holders agreed to a 4.99% beneficial ownership blocker and no short sales while holding warrants. Watch for completion, participation levels, and any remaining 2026 Notes overhang.
